context:
Source: tuning remediation plan rev2 (2026-10-01; adversarial re-review of develop d39166ea plus independent plan review). Plan task P1.5 (R-1b; plan review F9).

Delivered by PR #2636 (squash-merged 2026-10-04, merge SHA 0b257b24032cf06a8f1bddd081ca94dd95e1606d), per ADR-003 addendum "DuckDB partitioning" (PR #2634).

What shipped: partitioning removed from every examples/tunings/duckdb/*_tuned.yaml and the packaged mirrors in benchbox/core/tuning/templates/duckdb/ (examples and packaged copies stay byte-identical; TestPackagedTemplatesParity green). Per the ADR-001 constraint addendum, check_constraints.enabled is also false in the same tuned templates (CHECK cannot be verified against DuckDB's catalog). DuckDB partitioning was already registered rendered_via="none" in capability_registry.py (verified, unchanged). CHANGELOG [Unreleased] "Before you upgrade" notes the requested-config hash change.

Knock-on changes made in the same PR:
- benchbox/core/tuning/platform_capabilities.py: DuckDB temporal-partition logical candidates now map to UNSUPPORTED (they previously required a partitioning entry the templates can no longer carry). tests/unit/core/tuning/test_tpc_tuning_template_parity.py now asserts exactly that set (tpch 2, tpcds 6, ssb 1) as unsupported and everything else still mapped; assertions were corrected, not relaxed.
- The wizard and enable_platform_optimization read default table layouts from the packaged DuckDB template, so the partitioning slot would have silently vanished; it now comes from the new packaged reference benchbox/core/tuning/profiles/default_partitioning.yaml (values the DuckDB templates used to carry, all benchmarks), pinned per benchmark in tests/unit/core/tuning/test_duckdb_templates_no_partitioning.py. Other slots still come only from the DuckDB template.

Verification (acceptance):
- No DuckDB template (examples or packaged) contains a partitioning section: tests/unit/core/tuning/test_duckdb_templates_no_partitioning.py (also asserts CHECK is disabled); parity test passes.
- e2e: BENCHBOX_OUTPUT_DIR=<scratch> uv run -- benchbox run --platform duckdb --benchmark {tpch,tpcds} --scale 0.01 --tuning tuned --phases generate,load,power --queries 1 --non-interactive, and --benchmark ssb ... --queries Q1.1: all exit 0 and record dropped [] (zero partitioning drops). Statuses stay applied_unverified because PRIMARY KEY/FOREIGN KEY/UNIQUE statements have no catalog corroboration rule yet (tuning-constraint-corroboration); indexes corroborated 12 (tpch), 10 (ssb), 9 (tpcds), zero mismatch.
- pytest -m fast: 33900 passed. Independent subagent review, final head: no Critical/Required findings.

Follow-up noted by that review (not done here): the template edits also change the DuckDB tuned database name (e.g. tpch_sf1_custom_pk_fk_uniq_check_part_sort -> tpch_sf1_custom_pk_fk_uniq_sort), so previously cached tuned databases are rebuilt; the CHANGELOG entry does not mention it yet.
description:
## Problem
Every DuckDB tuned template requests partitioning, which DuckDB always drops (`duckdb.py:1453-1472`). The resulting dropped intents veto verification of the curated product path.

## Change (per gate D-7, option A expected)
- Remove `partitioning` from `examples/tunings/duckdb/*_tuned.yaml` and the packaged mirrors in `benchbox/core/tuning/templates/duckdb/`.
- Mark DuckDB partitioning `rendered_via="none"` in `capability_registry.py`.
- The validator turning this into an error depends on the D-5 amendment and the single-source validator item. Until then, the template change is the whole fix.

## Guardrails (must preserve)
- Keep `TestPackagedTemplatesParity` green.
- Note the requested-config hash change in release notes.

## Process guardrails
- One PR per item against `develop`, via the AGENTS.md worktree flow (`make worktree-claim BRANCH=...`, `make agent-write-preflight`).
- Verification ladder: `uv run -- python -m pytest -m fast -q`, `uv run -- ruff check .`, `uv run -- ruff format --check .` and `uv run -- ty check`.
- Then `make pr-preflight` and `make pr-open`.
- Stage explicit paths; never `git add -A`.
- No live cloud runs without explicit user approval stating the command, maximum runtime, log path and stop condition.
- Re-read every file:line anchor before editing. Anchors are from develop d39166ea.
